title: Integration by parts against a compactly supported Lipschitz vector field
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every C¹ function F : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), every K ∈ ℝ≥0 and every K-Lipschitz vector field g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support, ∫_{ℝⁿ} F(x)·div g(x) dx = −∫_{ℝⁿ} DF(x)[g(x)] dx, where div g(x) = trace Dg(x) is SimonGMT Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x (Dg = Mathlib fderiv, which is 0 at points of non-differentiability), DF(x) = fderiv ℝ F x, and both integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure (volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n) (K : ℝ≥0), ContDiff ℝ 1 F → LipschitzWith K g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ x, F x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x = -∫ x, fderiv ℝ F x (g x)
